name: Boing Boing

sources.title: Boing Boing homepage — long-running culture/tech blog
Contact page — help@boingboing.net for editors, inquiries@boingboing.net for ads
BBS thread — submit-a-link / Submitterator retired due to spam abuse
Historic 'how to get posted' guide — form-only, describe the link, include email and URL

requirements: Editorial blog — coverage is a curated post, not a directory listing
The old public submission form ('Submitterator' / suggest-a-link) was retired because human spam overwhelmed it
Current realistic routes: email the editors at help@boingboing.net, or engage on the BBS community (bbs.boingboing.net)
Advertising inquiries go to inquiries@boingboing.net — a separate paid channel
preparation: A link genuinely interesting to BB's culture/tech/weird-news sensibility — they post 'anomalies, curiosities, and eyebrow-raisers', not launch announcements
A short, descriptive note explaining what the link is and why it matters
Your email and the URL you want credited
workflow: Draft a concise tip describing the link and why it fits Boing Boing
Email help@boingboing.net (editorial contact per the current contact page)
Do not send follow-up reminder emails — historic guidance explicitly says not to
Alternatively share in the BBS community where editors participate
watchFor: Don't look for a submit form — it was killed by spam; only contact/BBS routes remain
Historic guidance said email submissions were never posted when a form existed; the situation has now inverted to email-only — expectations should be modest
Product-launch pitches are a poor fit; BB covers culture-worthy things, not standard SaaS launches
No paid-placement-for-coverage route exists (ads are display advertising only)
countsAsLive: A Boing Boing post linking to or covering the product is published on boingboing.net
unknowns: Whether editors still act on help@ tips for product submissions
Any current formal submission channel — none was found on the site
